learning_outcomes.text: Knows the theoretical and practical aspects of numerical methods used in engineering.
Performs numerical analyses for applications in various disciplines.
Knows the potential, limitations, strengths, and weaknesses of numerical methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to numerical methods, why numerical methods should be learned?, mathematical modeling and solution of engineering problems, role of computer software in numerical methods
Approximation and rounding errors, truncation errors and Taylor series expansion
Roots of algebraic equations: Closed methods (Graphical, bisection, false position methods), Open methods (Single-point iteration, Newton-Raphson and Secant methods, finding multiple roots)
Solution of non-linear algebraic equation systems: Newton-Raphson method, Computer-aided engineering applications
Linear equation systems: Review of Gauss methods, LU decomposition, Thomas algorithm, Computer applications, Engineering applications
Solution of maximum and minimum problems, Newton method, Lagrange multipliers method, Computer-aided engineering applications
Curve fitting: Least squares method (linear regression, polynomial regression, multiple linear regression, non-linear regression)
Interpolation (Newton's divided difference interpolation polynomials, Lagrange polynomials, Determination of coefficients of a polynomial)
Computer-aided curve fitting, Engineering applications related to curve fitting
Numerical differentiation and integration: Newton-Cotes formulas, numerical integral of equations, numerical differentiation
Computer-aided engineering applications related to numerical differentiation and integration
Ordinary differential equations: Single-step methods (Euler, modified and corrected Euler methods, Runge-Kutta methods), Numerical solution of first-order linear differential equation systems
Ordinary differential equations: Multi-step methods, Predictor-corrector methods, Initial and boundary-value problems, Computer-aided engineering applications
Introduction to partial differential equations: Finite difference method, Engineering applications
